newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian plane skids off runway, three injured.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian plane skids off runway, three injured.

text.p: A BAC 1-11 aircraft belonging to Nigeria's Aviation Development Company (ADC) skidded off the runway at eastern Calabar airport on Tuesday injuring three people, police and the airline said.
"The rain was very heavy and when the plane landed it skidded off the runway and into a ditch," said a police officer at the airport who witnessed the incident, contacted by telephone from Lagos.
"Preliminary reports say all passengers and crew were evacuated. Three passengers were taken to hospital and treated for injuries," a press statement from ADC in Lagos said.
The plane, which the airline said was carrying 49 passengers and six crew, left Lagos on a scheduled flight to Calabar, 500 km (310 miles) to the east.
An ADC Boeing-727 aircraft crashed into a lagoon near Lagos in November, killing 145 people on board.
The airline is seen by passengers as one of the best in Nigeria, which has a poor record of air safety.
